pr_title: AddOptionContract - throw if existing underlying equity not in Raw mode
pr_body:
#### Description
- `AddOptionContract` will now throw an exception if the underlying equity security has been added previously and the `DataNormalizationMode` has not been set to `DataNormalizationMode.Raw`
- Added `OptionChainProviderAlgorithm` to regression test suite

#### Related Issue
Closes #2064 

#### Motivation and Context
When working with options, the `DataNormalizationMode` for the underlying equity security must be set to Raw.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No

#### How Has This Been Tested?
OptionChainProviderAlgorithm locally, algorithm in #2064 in cloud

issue_context.title: Data normalization mode is adjusted in option algorithms with OptionChainProvider
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
The data normalization mode should be set to raw price in options algorithms with OptionChainPorvider
#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
The warning message informs that `the equity security was set the raw price normalization mode to work with options.` but the security price is still adjusted.
#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->
If commenting out `equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw);`, the filling price of IBM at 2017-01-03 09:31:00 is `$157.665765117USD`, the raw price should be `$167.23USD`.
#### Reproducing the Problem
<!--- Required for Bugs. Describe how to reproduce the problem. This can be via a failing unit test or a simplified algorithm that reliably demonstrates this issue.  -->

```using System.Linq;
using QuantConnect.Data;
using QuantConnect.Securities.Option;

namespace QuantConnect.Algorithm.CSharp
{

    public class OptionChainProviderAlgorithm : QCAlgorithm
    {
        private Symbol _equitySymbol;
        private Symbol _optionContract = string.Empty;

        public override void Initialize()
        {
            SetStartDate(2017, 1, 1);
            SetEndDate(2017, 1, 6);
            SetCash(100000);
            var equity = AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Minute);
            // equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw);
            _equitySymbol = equity.Symbol;
        }

        public override void OnData(Slice data)
        {
            if (!Portfolio[_equitySymbol].Invested)
            {
                MarketOrder(_equitySymbol, 100);
                Log(Securities[_equitySymbol].Price.ToString());
            }

            if (!(Securities.ContainsKey(_optionContract) && Portfolio[_optionContract].Invested))
            {
                var contracts = OptionChainProvider.GetOptionContractList(_equitySymbol, data.Time);
                var Calls = (from symbol in contracts
                                where symbol.ID.OptionRight == OptionRight.Call
                                select symbol);

                    _optionContract = Calls.OrderBy(x => x.ID.Date).FirstOrDefault();
                    AddOptionContract(_optionContract, Resolution.Minute);
           
            }
            if (Securities.ContainsKey(_optionContract) && !Portfolio[_optionContract].Invested)
            {
                MarketOrder(_optionContract, -1);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

comments:
Tricky one; as the `AddOptionContract` can be added at any time. Really it should probably throw an exception if the underlying isn't already in raw mode; since in this example it will have run ahead at least a day and the price in the data feed buffer/cache will all be adjusted.

`throw new ArgumentException("The underlying asset is set to " + security.DataNormalizationMode + ", please change this to DataNormalizationMode.Raw with the SetDataNormalization() method");`

review_comments: Any ideas on why this didn't change the regression statistics?
There were no split or dividends for GOOG after 12/24/2015, so there was no price adjustment even if the DataNormalizationMode was set to Adjusted.
